# `company.inventory_count_postings`

Journal entries that posted a physical count's derived differences.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | transactions.id | Journal entry carrying this posting of the count. |
| `count_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_inventory_count_postings_count | inventory_counts.id | Count whose differences the journal entry posts. |
| `purpose` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | record (the count recorded) or rederive (posted again after a re-derivation had voided the earlier entry). |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this count posting was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this count posting. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this count posting. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this count posting. |
